name: Permission
source:
Short and completed VN with non-avoidable NTR content.

The novel considers one of the options for answering the question: can the married couple separate love and passion, keeping their relationship?​
translation:
简短而完整的VN，其中包含不可避免的NTR内容。

小说考虑了回答这个问题的选项之一：已婚夫妇能否将爱情和激情分开，维持他们的关系？​
